notes: DAUDIT-2 (2026-10-08): this spec was written against the v1 FactCard (variant sourced / inference / counsel, operator ruling 2.4). Lane w10-factcard (2026-09-20) REPLACED that card with v2 (parts brief 2.1, artboard 21c) and removed the variant prop; the mount threw on mount and every row below read NOT BUILT. The mount now passes a FactCardModel in the three forms the brief fixes, and the values are re-expressed from the brief where the brief states them: LEFT EDGE 3px (was 2px); ink-family kinds edge #1A1A1A on a #F5F2EE band with the kind word #1A1A1A; orange-family kinds (ACTION REQUIRED, LEGAL CONFIRMATION REQUIRED) edge #F97316 on a #FFF7ED band with the kind word #F97316 (the v1 counsel label was ink, not orange); ANALYTICAL INFERENCE is 1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,.3) all round on a #FAFAF8 band with an italic body and no figure lead; the kind word is 10.5px/800/.12em uppercase on all three; the body row is a 132px 1fr 150px grid, gap 14, padding 12px 14px; the claim is 13px/1.6.

Values the brief does not restate keep their prior ruling (operator ruling 2.4): white card ground, 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12) on the top, right and bottom edges, radius 0 8px 8px 0 on the edge forms. Nothing here is a number chosen to make a row pass.
The forms are addressed through the mount's `[data-audit]` wrappers, which carry no styling of their own; `> div` inside each is the FactCard's own root element (data-part=fact-card).
